image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The subject displays an elongated oval body with eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates (valves) in yellow and orange hues, surrounded by a pinkish-purple leathery girdle. The background consists of blurred, textured rock surfaces.
